name: label
title: Label
description: A label component with asterisk indicator, sub-text, info icon, and composed mode. Uses namespace exports: Label.Root, Label.Asterisk, Label.Sub, Label.InfoIcon, Label.Info, Label.Composed.

migration.guide: v4 adds `Label.Composed` — a props-driven wrapper that renders Root, Asterisk, Sub, and Info via props (required, sub, info). No breaking changes from v3.

docs.lead: A label component with required asterisk indicator, optional sub-text, info tooltip, and a composed shorthand for common usage.
docs.usage:
import * as Label from "@/components/ui/label"

<Label.Composed required sub="(Optional)" info="Helpful tooltip">
  Field name
</Label.Composed>

examples.title: Demo
examples.description: Label with asterisk, sub-text, and info icon.

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Props-driven label with required, sub, and info.
examples.code:
<Label.Composed required sub="(Optional)" info="We use this address for account and billing updates.">
  Email
</Label.Composed>

api.name: Label.Root
api.description: The root label element built on Radix Label.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the label and apply disabled styling to all children

api.name: Label.Asterisk
api.description: Required-field asterisk. The glyph is aria-hidden and paired with visually hidden "(required)" text so assistive technology announces the state.

api.name: Label.Sub
api.description: Secondary text displayed after the label.

api.name: Label.InfoIcon
api.description: Standalone info circle SVG icon with default w-5 h-5 and text-text-disabled-300 color. Override via className.

api.name: Label.Info
api.description: Info icon wrapped in a tooltip. Pass tooltip text as children.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the icon-only tooltip trigger

api.name: Label.Composed
api.description: Props-driven label that renders Root, Asterisk, Sub, and Info based on props.

props.name: infoLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the info tooltip trigger
